name: Foundry
description: Foundry ships proven, client-ready software. From corporate web platforms to SaaS builds and API integrations, every project is engineered to a defined service level with a documented handover. Experimental products live in Labs; once they are sellable, they graduate to Foundry.

name: Intelligence
description: Intelligence develops and deploys AI models, machine learning solutions, and data science systems — from AI agents and chatbots to applied AI consulting. Security stays out of its scope; all security belongs to Infrastructure.

name: Infrastructure
description: Infrastructure owns everything security and hardware: cybersecurity across network, application, and cloud; IT infrastructure setup and management; network architecture; hardware sourcing and deployment; and on-site physical security systems. All security — including data security — sits here, never split across divisions.

name: Studio
description: Studio produces the output: live streaming, video production, photography, cinematography, 2D graphic design, 3D design and modeling, AR/VR content and experiences, and brand identity work. Where Labs builds AR/VR core technology, Studio makes AR/VR content.

name: Growth
description: Growth is the external business engine: business and management consulting, marketing strategy and campaigns, market research, sales enablement, and brand positioning. The industry verticals consume Growth's consulting rather than duplicating it.

name: Operations
description: Operations is the internal business engine: event planning and logistics, business process management, admin and back-office support, and vendor and partner coordination. Growth wins clients; Operations keeps everything running.

name: Academy
description: One Academy covering both technology and business: tech courses in development, AI, and design; business and management courses; certifications; and corporate training programs.

name: Labs
description: Labs incubates what is not yet sellable: deep-tech R&D in robotics and next-generation hardware, hardware prototyping, and future verticals in their experimental phase. When an experiment becomes a product, it graduates to the right division.

name: Vitality
description: The CloudAlls healthcare vertical, operating under the Pulse identity. Health-tech platforms and telemedicine, hospital and clinic management software, AI-assisted diagnostics, and wellness applications — powered by Foundry's engineering, Intelligence's AI, and Growth's market consulting.

name: Voyage
description: The CloudAlls travel and tourism vertical, operating under the Horizon identity. Travel booking platforms, destination marketing, tourism technology and consulting, and hospitality management systems.

name: Harvest
description: The CloudAlls food vertical, operating under the Foodworks identity. Food processing technology, food safety and quality systems, and agri-supply chain technology. Food processing belongs here exclusively.

name: Next Vertical
description: A reserved slot for CloudAlls' next industry vertical. New markets are researched in Labs and incubated here until they are ready to operate as a full vertical.
